# Likavcan.cz

> Professional website and engineering work hub of Lukáš Likavčan and Peter Likavčan.

## Lukáš Likavčan
- Canonical profile: https://likavcan.cz/lukas/
- Person URI: https://likavcan.cz/lukas/#lukas-likavcan
- Full name: Ing. Lukáš Likavčan, PhD.
- Job titles: Materials Engineer; Research and Development Specialist
- Education: MTF STU, Faculty of Materials Science and Technology in Trnava
- Current organization: BIZZCOM s.r.o.
- Focus: materials engineering, polymers, composites, injection moulding, plastics joining, numerical simulation and R&D
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-3949-6034
- Wikidata: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q139947576
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/luk%C3%A1%C5%A1-likav%C4%8Dan-74695b84
- Selected research project: MTF STU Young Researcher project No. 1341 (2015), quantitative material-structure analysis and injection-moulding process optimisation
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=rBvaSKQAAAAJ
- Publications: https://likavcan.cz/publications/
- Projects: https://likavcan.cz/projects/
- Materials research case study: https://likavcan.cz/projects/fibre-orientation-injection-moulding/
- Bezpečná elektrika case study: https://likavcan.cz/projects/bezpecna-elektrika/
